AGENDA
  YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Tuesday, February 27, 2024
  6:30 P.M.
  The three-fold mission of the Youth & Family Action Committee is:
  1. To support positive activities and opportunities for young people;
  2. To strengthen families; and
  3. To combat the problems of substance abuse.

1. WELCOME AND CALL TO ORDER

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, Chair
  Wendy Lau, Vice Chair
  Greg Palatto, BUSD Board Member
  Denise Fisher, Resident

 3.  SRO REPORT

minutes_text:
LA VERNE YOUTH & FAMILY ACTION COMMITTEE
  Minutes of the Regular Meeting
  February 27, 2024

1. A meeting of the Youth & Family Action Committee was called to order by Chair
  Rick Crosby at 6:31 p.m.

  Executive Board Members present:

  Executive Board
  Rick Crosby, YFAC Chair, Council Member
  Wendy Lau, Mayor Pro Tem
  Greg Palatto, BUSD
  Denise Fisher, Resident

2. Review of Minutes  Minutes for the January 23, 2024, meeting were
  approved.

3. SRO Report  Student Resource Officer (SRO) Eduardo Burgos
  shared that there was a career fair at Ramona Middle
  School on February 26 which focused on careers in
  specialized trades. Representatives from Waste
  Management, La Verne Fire, La Verne Police, and
  more came to speak with students about careers in
  their fields. SRO Burgos reported that SGV Care has
  been working with the school district and responding
  to situations with students who are having mental
  crises and need support.

4. BUSD Report  Mark Rodgers from BUSD reported that the career
  tech department is looking at summer opportunities
  for the kids to take advantage of in addition to
  organizing career fairs. The district is working on
  creating the summer elementary programs including
  summer daycare which will provide reading
  academies for students who need additional reading
  support. The district is focusing on removing barriers
  to providing access to supportive resources for the
  families who most need it.

5. Budget Update  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells reported that
  during the mid-year budget process, City Council will
  formally adopt the YFAC budget into the City’s budget.
  He will report out the status of YFAC’s budget at a
  later meeting.

6. Teach & Transform Grant  Assistant City Manager JR Ranells provided the group
  with an update on the new grant program sharing that
  there have been two submissions to date. The district
  is planning on doing another push out to staff and the
  deadline for submissions is March 21, 2024.
 Youth & Family Action Committee Minutes February 27, 2024, page 2

7. Meeting Time Consideration Assistant City Manager JR Ranells reported that the
  Youth & Family Action Committee bylaws allow for a
  change in the meeting time for the group. YFAC Chair
  Rick Crosby proposed a meeting time of 5:00 p.m. to
  the group which was approved by all present voting
  members.

8. Student Report  The Bonita High School YFAC student liaisons
  reported to the group about things happening in the
  district right now. They shared that the second phase
  of the PACE Senior Project has been completed which
  involved volunteer hours and a research paper. The
  next stage of the project is to do a presentation in front
  of an oral board. Additionally, the students shared that
  the Culinary Arts class recently won a competition.

9. Public Comment  Robin Carder asked the group about a program she
  heard about where students could leave campus for a
  religious program. Mark Rodgers of BUSD shared
  more about what he knew about the program including
  that the district is not involved in it.

  YFAC Chair Rick Crosby shared that he would like to
  have the La Verne Fire Department be invited to be a
  part of the Youth & Family Action Committee.
  Lieutenant Cory Leeper shared that the Little League
  leadership are also interested in joining the group.
  Councilmember Crosby noted that all organized
  programs for children would be welcome at YFAC.

  Mayor Pro Tem Wendy Lau shared information that
  Tri-Cities Mental Health has provided regarding the
  upcoming election and Proposition 1 and encouraged
  members of the community to learn about that
  proposition.

10. Next Meeting  The next YFAC meeting was scheduled for March 26,
  2024, at 5:00 p.m.

11. Adjournment  The meeting was adjourned at 7:32 p.m.

Respectfully submitted,

Erin Beilstein
Management Analyst
